jobs.title: DatePicker availability parity
jobs.task: Implement K04-datepicker-entry-parity from wave-02-11/report.md. The exact defect probe is wave-02-11/acceptance.test.tsx. Validate date-only text, segments, and datetime candidates through the same unavailable-array and getDateUnavailableReason policy as the calendar. Retain invalid draft text/feedback timing; forbidden candidates must not emit accepted callbacks or named hidden values; native validity and onValidityChange must block submission/outer Apply. Check current host rules for datetime Apply and disabled/readOnly commits. Prefer private owned validation plumbing over unnecessary new public props. If a public contract change is unavoidable, explain and leave exact docs follow-up rather than edit other owners' files. Do not merely reject callback after native form validity already says valid. Add focused regression for text callback/array parity, native hidden values/controlled authority, segments and datetime. Run Node24 affected unit suites only, no shared build.

jobs.title: Calendar dynamic availability explanations
jobs.files: packages/ui/src/experimental/Calendar/Calendar.tsx; packages/ui/src/experimental/Calendar/Calendar.test.tsx; optional new private helper/test under that Calendar directory only
jobs.task: Implement K17-callback-reason-access from wave-02-11/report.md. A Calendar using getDateUnavailableReason alone disables a day but supplies no non-hover explanation. Expose dynamic and static reasons consistently through focused-cell descriptions/status and/or keyboard/touch availability disclosure; preserve complete localized date labels, native selected/disabled semantics and owned associations. Remove stale owned reasons on callback/selection replacement without deleting host description references. Test callback replacement/removal, date focus and disabled/readOnly behavior. DatePicker composes this Calendar automatically. Reuse existing private ref-bridge/availability patterns rather than inventing upstream public types. Add focused colocated tests and run Node24 affected suites only; no shared builds/native/browser suites.
